mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) over the past two months indicates inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or if the correlation between CPI increases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or if the correlation between UNRATE increases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over the past month indicates weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or if the correlation between RSAFS declines and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) signals strengthening economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of instances despite the positive signal, or if the correlation between INDPRO increases and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) combined with a rise in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) indicates accommodative monetary policy in an inflationary environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS decreases > 0.25% and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% in 2 months
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or if the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with a rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS declines > 100k and UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 1 month
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or if the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) signals strengthening demand in the housing sector, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or if the correlation between HOUST increases and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, especially in a late-cycle expansion regime.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO increases > 1% and UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp in 2 months
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or if the interaction effect is not statistically significant in a late-cycle expansion regime (p > 0.05).
